species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 46°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 8–20 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 105 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 160 ft, so fish stay above it.
Northwest wind at 20 mph pushes bait onto the southeast shore: try the wind-blown banks.
